subject: Jensen Huang plots comeback, Apple to unveil smart glasses at WWDC
notes: Issue is headed 'Sun, Nov 15'. Headlines only; no per-item event dates stated.

stories.headline: Databento raised a $100M Series C at a $1.1B valuation
stories.quote: DATABENTO, WHICH OFFERS MARKET DATA APIS AND SAYS IT HAS CONTRACTS WITH FIVE OF THE SIX LARGEST FRONTIER AI LABS, RAISED A $100M SERIES C AT A $1.1B VALUATION
stories.description: Market data APIs; contracts with five of six largest frontier AI labs

stories.headline: Charta Health raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners
stories.quote: CHARTA HEALTH, WHICH OFFERS AI-POWERED TOOLS TO AUTOMATE MEDICAL CHART REVIEW, BILLING, AND CODING WORKFLOWS, RAISED A $55M SERIES B LED BY INSIGHT PARTNERS
stories.description: AI tools automating medical chart review, billing and coding workflows

stories.headline: Operand raised $31M across a seed and a Series A led by Khosla Ventures at a $220M valuation
stories.quote: OPERAND, WHICH OFFERS AI-POWERED DUE DILIGENCE TOOLS FOR PE FIRMS, RAISED $31M ACROSS A SEED AND A SERIES A LED BY KHOSLA VENTURES AT A $220M VALUATION
stories.description: AI-powered due diligence tools for PE firms
stories.stage_as_written: a seed and a Series A

stories.headline: Tendrils raised $30M led by Benchmark
stories.quote: CAMBRIDGE, UK-BASED TENDRILS, WHICH IS DESIGNING A CPU ARCHITECTURE WITH THOUSANDS OF CORES OPERATING IN PARALLEL, RAISED $30M LED BY BENCHMARK
stories.description: Designing a CPU architecture with thousands of cores operating in parallel

stories.headline: Luminal raised a $25M Series A
stories.quote: LUMINAL, WHICH PROVIDES AN INFERENCE CLOUD AND DEVELOPS INFERENCE COMPILER SOFTWARE TO TEST RUNNING AI MODELS ON DIFFERENT CHIPS, RAISED A $25M SERIES A
stories.description: Inference cloud and inference compiler software for running models on different chips

stories.headline: Whitematter raised a $20M Series A
stories.quote: WHITEMATTER, WHICH BUILDS “GUARDIAN” AI AGENTS TO OVERSEE FILE ACCESS, SOFTWARE USE, DECISION MAKING, AND ACTIONS OF EXISTING AI AGENTS, RAISED A $20M SERIES A
stories.description: Builds "guardian" AI agents that oversee actions of existing AI agents

stories.headline: Nidus raised $30M across a pre-seed and a seed
stories.quote: NIDUS, WHICH IS DEVELOPING AI-POWERED TECH FOR MANUFACTURING ROBOTS USED BY US DEFENSE INDUSTRIAL COMPANIES, RAISED $30M ACROSS A PRE-SEED AND A SEED
stories.description: AI-powered tech for manufacturing robots used by US defense industrial companies

stories.headline: Nebuly raised a $21M Series A
stories.quote: NEBULY, WHOSE TECH HELPS ENTERPRISES MEASURE THE BUSINESS VALUE OF AI AGENTS BY ANALYZING THEIR IMPACT ON PRODUCTIVITY AND REVENUE, RAISED A $21M SERIES A
stories.description: Helps enterprises measure the business value of AI agents

stories.headline: Sources: Anthropic's IPO is about 7x oversubscribed; up to $90.4B sought via IPO and a separate private placement
stories.quote: SOURCES: ANTHROPIC'S IPO IS ~7X OVERSUBSCRIBED; ANTHROPIC AND SOME OF ITS BACKERS ARE SEEKING TO RAISE UP TO $90.4B VIA THE IPO AND A SEPARATE PRIVATE PLACEMENT

facts.text: IPO reported by sources as about 7x oversubscribed
Anthropic and some backers seek to raise up to $90.4B through the IPO plus a separate private placement (one combined figure)
facts.quote: ANTHROPIC AND SOME OF ITS BACKERS ARE SEEKING TO RAISE UP TO $90.4B VIA THE IPO AND A SEPARATE PRIVATE PLACEMENT

stories.headline: Analysis values Sam Bankman-Fried's former Anthropic stake at about $37B if Anthropic lists at about $1.5T
stories.quote: ANALYSIS: SAM BANKMAN-FRIED'S $500M ANTHROPIC INVESTMENT IN 2021 WOULD BE WORTH ~$37B IF ANTHROPIC LISTS AT ~$1.5T; HE RELINQUISHED HIS STAKE IN 2024 FOR ~$1.3B

facts.text: Analysis assumes a listing at about $1.5T; a $500M 2021 investment would then be worth about $37B
facts.quote: SAM BANKMAN-FRIED'S $500M ANTHROPIC INVESTMENT IN 2021 WOULD BE WORTH ~$37B IF ANTHROPIC LISTS AT ~$1.5T

facts.text: Bankman-Fried relinquished the stake in 2024 for about $1.3B
facts.quote: HE RELINQUISHED HIS STAKE IN 2024 FOR ~$1.3B

stories.headline: Background: Sam Bankman-Fried invested $500M in Anthropic in 2021
stories.quote: ANALYSIS: SAM BANKMAN-FRIED'S $500M ANTHROPIC INVESTMENT IN 2021 WOULD BE WORTH ~$37B IF ANTHROPIC LISTS AT ~$1.5T; HE RELINQUISHED HIS STAKE IN 2024 FOR ~$1.3B

facts.text: $500M is one investor's 2021 investment, not a stated round size

stories.headline: JD.com completes takeover of Ceconomy after acquiring about 60% for about $1.5B
stories.quote: JD.COM COMPLETES ITS TAKEOVER OF GERMAN ELECTRONICS RETAILER CECONOMY, AFTER ACQUIRING A ~60% STAKE FOR ~$1.5B, FOLLOWING THE EU'S APPROVAL OF THE DEAL

facts.text: Stake acquired is about 60%; completion followed EU approval
facts.quote: AFTER ACQUIRING A ~60% STAKE FOR ~$1.5B, FOLLOWING THE EU'S APPROVAL OF THE DEAL

stories.headline: TSMC plans a new $500M fund to invest in chip startups, suppliers and upstream partners
stories.quote: TSMC PLANS TO SET UP A NEW $500M FUND TO INVEST IN CHIP STARTUPS, SUPPLIERS, AND OTHER UPSTREAM PARTNERS, SAYING “WE ALSO WANT TO SUPPORT THE FUTURE'S NVIDIA”
stories.fund_focus: chip startups, suppliers and upstream partners

stories.headline: Sources: Jensen Huang has discussed a comeback as Nvidia CEO; allies form a "war room" to lobby for his return
stories.quote: SOURCES: JENSEN HUANG HAS DISCUSSED A COMEBACK AS NVIDIA CEO WITH CONFIDANTS, AS ALLIES FORM A “WAR ROOM” TO LOBBY FOR HIS RETURN AND SEEK WHITE HOUSE SUPPORT

facts.text: Petition to reinstate Huang tops 100K signatures; organizers say 5K+ Nvidia staff signed
facts.quote: A PETITION TO REINSTATE JENSEN HUANG AS NVIDIA CEO TOPS 100K SIGNATURES, INCLUDING ELON MUSK, TIM SWEENEY, AND GARRY TAN; ORGANIZERS SAY 5K+ NVIDIA STAFF SIGNED

facts.text: Altimeter's Brad Gerstner and Atreides's Gavin Baker, owning $2.13B in Nvidia, urge the board to consider Huang's return
facts.quote: LETTER: ALTIMETER'S BRAD GERSTNER AND ATREIDES'S GAVIN BAKER URGE NVIDIA'S BOARD TO CONSIDER “THE POTENTIAL RETURN OF JENSEN HUANG”; THEY OWN $2.13B IN NVIDIA

stories.headline: Scott Bessent urges Nvidia to hire an outside CEO and wants answers within 10 days on China chip sales
stories.quote: SCOTT BESSENT URGES NVIDIA TO HIRE AN OUTSIDE CEO AND WANTS ANSWERS WITHIN 10 DAYS ON WHETHER IT PUSHED “SEEMINGLY ILLICIT” CHIP SALES TO CHINA TO BOOST REVENUE

stories.headline: Sources: Apple plans to unveil smart glasses at WWDC and ship them by end of 2027
stories.quote: SOURCES: APPLE PLANS TO UNVEIL SMART GLASSES AT WWDC AND SHIP THEM BY THE END OF 2027, FOCUSING HEAVILY ON INTEGRATION OF THIRD-PARTY IPHONE APPS WITH SIRI AI

stories.headline: Tesla opens Cybercab orders to select customers at $30K plus a required $299/month autonomy subscription
stories.quote: TESLA SAYS “SELECT CUSTOMERS” CAN NOW PLACE ORDERS FOR ITS CYBERCAB “FOR PERSONAL USE”, FOR $30K PLUS A REQUIRED $299/MONTH AUTONOMY SUBSCRIPTION TO OPERATE

facts.text: Subscription agreement limits the vehicles to Tesla-enabled geofences, which Tesla can change at any time
facts.quote: TESLA'S CYBERCAB AUTONOMY SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT STATES THE VEHICLES WILL ONLY WORK INSIDE TESLA-ENABLED GEOFENCES, WHICH THE COMPANY CAN CHANGE AT ANY TIME

stories.headline: Italy's data protection agency fines Meta €805M over access to Android users' photos and videos
stories.quote: ITALY'S DATA PROTECTION AGENCY FINES META €805M FOR ALLEGEDLY ACCESSING ANDROID USERS' PHOTOS AND VIDEOS WITHOUT THEIR CONSENT OR INFORMING THEM

stories.headline: US and Pax Silica allies agree to create a joint list of AI technologies and supply chains to protect from China
stories.quote: THE US AND PAX SILICA ALLIES, INCLUDING JAPAN, THE UK, AND INDIA, AGREE TO CREATE A JOINT LIST OF AI TECHNOLOGIES AND SUPPLY CHAINS TO PROTECT FROM CHINA

stories.headline: Amazon loses 40 Leo satellites after ULA's Vulcan rocket fails 10 minutes into flight
stories.quote: AMAZON LOSES 40 LEO SATELLITES AFTER ULA'S VULCAN ROCKET FAILS 10 MINUTES INTO FLIGHT, MARKING THE FIRST MISSION FAILURE FOR THE BOEING-LOCKHEED JOINT VENTURE

stories.headline: Trump Media faces a Nov. 30 deadline to repay up to $1B in convertible bonds; shares down 60+% this year
stories.quote: TRUMP MEDIA FACES A NOV. 30 DEADLINE TO REPAY UP TO $1B IN CONVERTIBLE BONDS SOLD LAST MAY TO FUND A “BITCOIN TREASURY,” AS ITS SHARES ARE DOWN 60+% THIS YEAR

facts.text: Deadline to repay up to $1B in convertible bonds
facts.quote: TRUMP MEDIA FACES A NOV. 30 DEADLINE TO REPAY UP TO $1B IN CONVERTIBLE BONDS SOLD LAST MAY

stories.headline: Microsoft says all Microsoft 365 products are operational, ending a global outage
stories.quote: MICROSOFT SAYS ALL MICROSOFT 365 PRODUCTS ARE OPERATIONAL, ENDING AN OUTAGE THAT DISRUPTED GOVERNMENTS, TRADERS, HOSPITALS, AND BUSINESSES AROUND THE WORLD
